{
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # A separator divides the grid into two masks; output their overlap in color 2.
    # ARC instances may place the separator as a row or as a column.
    row_sep = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0), None)
    if row_sep is not None:
        first, second = grid[:row_sep], grid[row_sep + 1:]
        return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(r1, r2)] for r1, r2 in zip(first, second)]
    col_sep = next(j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[j] == 7 for row in grid))
    left = [row[:col_sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[col_sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(r1, r2)] for r1, r2 in zip(left, right)]
"
}
